research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01: empty frozen occupation list is not zero experience. First speech and school-affiliated biography establish substantive pre-parliament jobs absent from extract. Local annual report and association records distinguish employment from elected/governance offices.

Follow-up: SSTUWA title and dates/hours, earlier UK/Australian employment and study, exact school payroll entity/hours/leave, all gaps and overlap with council service; association appointment/end and pay basis; school-placement details. School annual records/payroll or legitimate professional profile would be strongest next sources.

Searches included official/member material, school/employer sites, council/association annual reports, full-time terms and union employment. Unrelated actress, US lawyer, NZ executive assistant, health-care marketer and namesake professional profiles not adopted. School-site full-time mayor descriptor cannot establish registrar hours.

Own20-year public-service marketing description refers to political/community service, not codebook public-service employment. Generic summaries ending mayor role on election day contradicted by local authority June2022 resignation. Pre-first-campaign secondary school chronology retained as gap, not used to alter primary year range.
